name: Iris
source:
Main character and his partner Seti helped two adventurers who were attacked on their way back from friend's wedding. The innkeeper asked them to find the attackers, and that marked the beginning of their journey.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公和他的搭档赛蒂帮助了两名在朋友婚礼归途中遭到袭击的冒险者。旅馆老板请他们追查袭击者，这标志着他们旅程的开始。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
